categories.main_business_segments: Kewell Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: testing power supplies, hydrogen energy testing and intelligent manufacturing equipment, and power semiconductor testing and intelligent manufacturing equipment. These segments serve industries including new energy power generation, electric vehicles, hydrogen fuel cells, and power semiconductors. The company provides integrated testing systems and smart manufacturing solutions tailored to these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics conversion technologies such as high-dynamic multi-BUCK conversion, low-harmonic PWM grid-feeding technology, high-voltage cascaded multi-level conversion, and multi-CPU multi-machine parallel control. It also develops proprietary precision measurement and control technologies, electrochemical integration for hydrogen energy testing, and semiconductor testing technologies including SiC device testing. Production combines make-to-order and inventory-based manufacturing to meet customized and standardized product demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kewell serves key customers in strategic emerging industries such as photovoltaic power generation, electric vehicles, hydrogen fuel cells, and power semiconductors. Its products are also applied in rail transit, automotive electronics, aerospace, medical, microgrids, and laboratory certification sectors. The company maintains strong relationships with leading domestic and international clients, including strategic customers in China and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has expanded its global footprint through overseas distributors and agents, with significant market presence in Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and a wholly-owned subsidiary in the Netherlands. Domestic sales dominate revenue, but international sales have shown significant growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kewell operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized testing equipment and intelligent manufacturing systems. It sources raw materials and components from suppliers, manages production, and sells finished testing systems to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with substantial R&D investment (16.5% of revenue in 2024). Strategic priorities include advancing testing power supply series, expanding hydrogen energy testing capabilities (fuel cells and electrolyzers), and enhancing power semiconductor testing solutions, including SiC device testing. It pursues platform-based and modular product development, collaborates with universities, and focuses on product standardization, automation, and digitalization to improve efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Kewell generates revenue primarily through the sale of testing power supplies, hydrogen energy testing equipment, and power semiconductor testing systems. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales complemented by a growing distribution network. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with some products requiring installation and commissioning before revenue recognition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in testing power supplies and integrated testing equipment, competing with international giants like Keysight, Ametek, and Horiba in various segments. It has achieved import substitution in several product lines and is recognized for its cost-effectiveness and service quality. In hydrogen energy and power semiconductor testing, it competes with established international brands and emerging domestic companies, gradually increasing market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kewell reported revenue of approximately RMB 478 million, a 9.58% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 49 million, down 58.1%. The company maintains total assets around RMB 1.7 billion and equity of RMB 1.3 billion. Despite short-term revenue decline due to order delays and increased expenses, the company sustains a solid order backlog and continues investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kewell differentiates itself by providing comprehensive, high-reliability testing solutions tailored to emerging strategic industries with a focus on innovation and customization. Its products feature advanced power electronics technologies, high precision, modular design, and integration capabilities. The company emphasizes domestic innovation, import substitution, and strong after-sales service, offering customers cost-effective, scalable, and industry-compliant testing equipment that supports their R&D and production needs.
